theorems.name: Submission.rsod_c1_range_subset_submanifold_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Amb n ℓ), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ∃ (N₀ : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (N : ℕ → Set (Amb n ℓ)), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N₀ = 0 ∧ (∀ q, IsC1Submanifold n (N q) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (N q) < ∞) ∧ range G ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ q, N q
